title: Pattern in the Last N Samples
constraints: Consider the last **12** samples of `din` (including the one taken at the latest edge). Samples before reset count as 0.
`count` = number of 1s in that window. `alarm = 1` when `count ≥ 8`.
Update `count` **incrementally** (+ new sample − sample leaving the window). Don't re-count all 12 bits every cycle. Registered outputs, synchronous reset. Must be synthesizable.
hints: A 12-bit shift register holds the window. The bit falling off the end is `window[11]`.
`count_next = count + din − window[11]`: an up/down counter.
`alarm` can be registered alongside, computed from `count_next`.

examples.title: 8 of 12
examples.input: pattern with exactly 8 ones in the window
